dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 2.5 years old / 38 lbs

GENDER: Male

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - Yes, Cats - TBD

ABOUT ME: Hugs are my love language, and I hand them out freely, usually with a (mostly) gentle kiss on the side. I’m happiest wrestling with a dog friend, making the rounds to greet the neighbors, or tagging along wherever my people go. I even worked the crowd at a marathon. At night, it’s Hallmark and couch time with the family. Sometimes my foster sister ends up riding on my back. I consider that teamwork.

MY FOSTER SAYS: “Tumblr’s essence is adventure buddy who is happy to be included and greets each day like, ‘Good morning! What shall we do today, people?’ (Okay if the answer is sometimes lazy day of lounging and cuddling.)”

HISTORY

Tumblr was found as a stray in Georgia and taken in temporarily by a kind stranger. When her work took her back on the road, she was no longer able to care for him, and he was boarding at a local vet’s office when we met him. He traveled to Brooklyn in mid-October 2026.

DETAILED PROFILE

Tumblr greets each morning like he’s waiting to hear the plan. He’s an eager, goofy adventure buddy who mostly wants to be included, and people regularly mistake him for a puppy. By evening he’s usually happy to settle in for a Hallmark movie with the family.

His energy varies by the day and runs high when he’s fresh, and he’s surprisingly athletic; at daycare he’s been spotted clearing a gate divider in one graceful arc. He hands out hugs and (mostly) gentle kisses to everyone, and he handled a marathon crowd and busy dog-friendly bars like a champ. He’s been sweet with school-age and older kids, though with very young ones his exuberance and loose grasp of personal space call for care. An active family that brings him along on adventures would suit him well.

Other dogs are a highlight. He loves rough-and-tumble wrestling with willing partners and has been a hit at daycare. When a bossy dog corrects him, he shows no interest in a fight. A dog sibling would be a bonus, not a requirement. He recently peered calmly at two bodega cats through a shop door, an encouraging early sign, though cats are still unknown.

He knows sit, place, off, and come, but as he’s gotten comfortable his puppyish side has grown, and he needs structure. Given too much freedom he’ll investigate the kitchen counters, and walks can turn into a zigzag. House training started out spotless but has slipped: he’s had crate accidents when the other dogs go out without him, plus a few in his building’s hallway and elevator. A consistent routine, clear rules, and regular chances to burn energy will help him shine.

Bring a leash, a plan, and a free afternoon. He’ll supply the enthusiasm

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
